whatWasBuilt: A small C++ C-API executable linked with the selected libcef import library; NOT CEF/Chromium itself.

futureControlledBuild.reason: Native RTC-off/SW-off and network/source gates are absent/unverified in consumed standard artifact.
futureControlledBuild.strategy: Own CEF/Chromium build and explicit native gates. A conceptual point is not an implemented/certified patch.

reproducibility.harness: Pinned distribution checksum/ABI/source hashes + MSVC/SDK. Link rebuild deterministic claim not made.
reproducibility.engineBuild: Needs pinned depot_tools/GN/Ninja/Clang/source deps/toolchain and reproducibility measurements. No promise from consuming a tar archive.

updateBurden: High: carry native patches across each Chromium/CEF security release and invalidate certification on changed code/config; never freeze an insecure build indefinitely.
patchCarry: Maintain exact native surface, all partitions/worker/NetworkService restarts and regression evidence. No estimate of number of LOC/engineering weeks asserted.
windowsDistribution: App-local private fixed runtime/resources, publisher update pipeline, third-party notices preserved in distribution. No admin install is inherent to this shape.
